_comment: Phase B1 — Coverage catalog: every business outcome the harness claims to test. See docs/scoring-system-roadmap.md §1 B1. The catalog is the single source of truth that connects (test method) → (outcome id) → (verifier) → (severity for scoring weight). Additions require PR review. Removals require either retiring the test or migrating the outcome to a new test.
_severityNote: CRITICAL = release-blocking outcomes (auth, payment, core connect creation). HIGH = visible to most users (marketing flows, navigation health). MEDIUM = secondary flows. LOW = edge cases. Severity drives B5 coverage-weighted score multiplier.
